reviews.title: Worst Subscription Renewal Experience
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with your subscription service. For several days, I tried to renew my subscription from my own account. You kept showing attractive offer plans, but every time I tried to pay, I got the error: “Current plan is not required for your account.” Fine, I thought maybe the offer wasn’t applicable, so I tried paying the regular price. Even that failed with a generic “We’re sorry” error. If my account isn’t eligible, don’t show me those offers in the first place. And if there’s an issue with my account, provide a proper explanation instead of vague error messages. What is even more frustrating is that I had to use my husband’s number to subscribe, and it worked instantly on the first attempt. So clearly, the problem was with your system, not my payment or device. This was a frustrating and confusing experience. Please fix your subscription system and provide clear error messages instead of making loyal users waste their time.

reviews.title: Amman Naidu
reviews.text:
Please consider developing the iOS app natively using Swift/SwiftUI instead of a cross-platform framework like Flutter or React Native. The current implementation doesn't provide the same smooth, responsive, and polished experience that users typically expect from a native iOS app.

A native iOS implementation would help deliver better animations, gesture handling, UI consistency, and overall performance, resulting in a much more authentic iOS feel.

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text:
Worst streaming app experience. Period.

This app never works as expected. Not once. Forget TV support. Apple TV is a joke. Even on mobile, where it should at least be stable, it constantly fails.

You open the app, it hangs.
You close it. Open again.
Repeat this multiple times just to watch one thing.

Sometimes it doesn’t even show the Play button. That’s not a bug, that’s absurd. A streaming app where you can’t play content. Very funny, honestly. I’m not sure how the app expects users to watch anything at all.

The usual response is always the same: reinstall, update, contact support, wait for fixes. I’ve done all of that. Multiple times. Nothing changes. The problems are clearly deeper than “use the latest version.”

If basic functionality like opening the app, recognizing subscriptions, and showing a play button doesn’t work reliably, updates and scripted support replies don’t help. The core experience is broken.

This is easily one of the worst app experiences I’ve had. Until the fundamentals are fixed, this app is simply not usable.

reviews.title: Worst App
reviews.text:
I paid ₹500 for a 1-year subscription, but my account is still not activated. It has been more than 4 days, and despite multiple follow-ups with customer care, there is zero resolution.

This is extremely frustrating and unprofessional. Taking payment is instant, but activating the account or providing proper support seems impossible for them. Customer care keeps giving false assurances with no actual action.

This feels like a complete waste of money and time. If you cannot activate accounts after receiving payment, you should not be selling subscriptions in the first place. Very poor service, no accountability, and terrible customer support.

I do NOT recommend this service to anyone.
